privacy_description: What EMLy accesses, what stays on your device, and what is ever sent elsewhere.
privacy_overview_text: EMLy is an internal desktop application built by 3gIT for viewing .eml and .msg email files, including Italian PEC certified emails. This page explains what data EMLy accesses, what stays on your device, and what is sent elsewhere.
privacy_email_text: Email files you open in EMLy — subject, body, attachments, and PEC signatures — are parsed and rendered entirely on your device. EMLy never uploads the contents of an email file anywhere.
privacy_settings_text: Your theme, language, and feature preferences are stored only in local browser storage on your device. They are never transmitted anywhere.
privacy_device_text: To verify EMLy is running on a device approved for its use case, EMLy reads your hostname, Active Directory domain, operating system, hardware ID, internal IP address, and basic CPU/RAM information. This data is processed locally and shown to you in Settings; it never leaves your device unless you submit a bug report.
privacy_bugreport_text: Submitting a bug report is optional and requires your action. If you submit one, EMLy bundles the name and email you type into the form, your description, a screenshot, your browser's local storage contents, and the device/diagnostic information above, and uploads it to 3gIT's own bug-report service. This data is never shared with third parties.
privacy_thirdparty_text: The Credits page fetches public GitHub profile information (name, avatar) for EMLy's contributors. No data about you is sent to GitHub.
privacy_retention_text: EMLy is provided by 3gIT for use on company-managed devices and is governed by your organization's IT policies. For questions about this policy, or to request deletion of a submitted bug report, contact your TL/RDS.
